validation.title: Validation Method
items: Multiply the first 9 digits by weights 1·3·7·1·3·7·1·3·5 and add them
Add the quotient of (9th digit × 5) ÷ 10 once more
The check digit is 10 minus the last digit of the sum (0 if 10)
A valid check digit does not prove registration — use the status lookup

whatIs.title: What is the Business Registration Number Validator?
whatIs.description: This tool validates 10-digit Korean business registration numbers instantly using the NTS check-digit algorithm. It breaks down the number (tax office code, type code, serial), validates many numbers at once with CSV export, and checks active/suspended/closed status via the NTS status service.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Type or paste a number. Spaces, hyphens and dots are cleaned up and formatted as 000-00-00000.
2. Once 10 digits are entered, validity, the breakdown and the check-digit calculation appear immediately.
3. For valid numbers, press 'Check NTS status' to see if the business is active or closed. If unavailable, use the Hometax link.
4. For many numbers, paste an Excel column into the Bulk tab and download the results as CSV.

tips.title: Tips
items: The check digit only catches typos. Before a transaction, also check whether the business is closed.
Bulk-validate supplier numbers before issuing tax invoices to avoid rejections.
Copy the result link (?n=number) to share the same result.

items.q: Can a number pass validation but not actually exist?
items.a: Yes. The check digit only confirms the structure. Registration and active/closed status must be checked with the status lookup or on Hometax.

Corporate registration numbers (13 digits) are a different format, but 10-digit business registration numbers of corporations use the same algorithm. Middle digits 81/86/87/88 mean a for-profit head office, 85 a branch.

items.q: Is my number sent to a server?
items.a: Validation and breakdown run only in your browser. Only when you press 'Check NTS status' is the number sent to the NTS lookup service (data.go.kr); this site does not store it.
